summary: Vocotap iter19 — LIVE verified all 4 requested flows on https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) SETTINGS 390x844: /settings renders auto-performance-toggle ON by default directly above performance-mode-toggle inside the 'PERFORMANCE MODE' section (DOM compareDocumentPosition confirmed auto before perf). Toggling, navigating / -> /settings, and the toggle state is preserved (visual confirmation; the RN Switch on web doesn't surface aria-checked so programmatic value reads 'undefined' — this is expected RN-Web behavior, not a bug). (2) GAMEPLAY 390x844: /guide -> page.mouse.click on guide-play-tutorial-button bbox navigated to /game?tutorial=1; gameplay-hud appeared, SongIntroCard then countdown cleared, hud-score read '0' after countdown, pressing A/S/D/F 30 times rapidly drove hud-score to 900 — HUD updates correctly, no red screen, no console errors beyond pre-existing shim deprecations and the Treesh CORS warning. (3) PERFORMANCE MODE ON gameplay: toggled performance-mode-toggle ON in settings, started tutorial — gameplay still ran smoothly (hud-score 450 after 15*4 key presses), lite visuals active (beat grid lines absent in screenshot), no crash. perf-mode-toast not expected on fast dev hardware per spec. (4) EDITOR COPY/PASTE 390x844: /library?pick=editor -> device-library-chip -> song-card-neon-warmup -> tutorial-skip-button -> editor-board. Flow: editor-snap-off, editor-tool-tap, placed 3 taps at (0.3,0.65)(0.55,0.55)(0.75,0.45) with page.mouse.click -> editor-note-count='3 NOTES · 143 BPM · CUSTOM' ✓. Switched to editor-tool-select, page.mouse.down at (board.x+40%, bottom-20) -> move(+30, -250, steps=10) -> up -> editor-inspector appeared with '2 NOTES SELECTED' and the Earlier/Later/Lane/Lane/Delete + Copy 2/Duplicate/Paste rows ✓. editor-inspector-copy clicked (toast 'Selected 2 notes' visible in screenshot) ✓. editor-inspector-duplicate: 3 -> 5 notes ✓. editor-inspector-close, clicked editor-timeline at 60% to move playhead, editor-paste-button appeared and read 'Paste 2': 5 -> 7 notes (toast 'Pasted 2 notes' visible) ✓. editor-undo-button: 7 -> 5 (reverts) ✓. (5) DESKTOP 1440x900: home (/) 2-column — browse-library-button right-edge=899 vs daily-challenge-card/home-progress-card left-edge=922 (no overlap) ✓. /library — 2-col: first song-card at left=246 width=466, second at left=724 same top=247 (sameRow=2) ✓. /shop — 2-col: 7 skin-card-* + 4 theme-card-*, two cards in first row (sameRow=2, first left=246, second left=721) ✓. /settings, /guide, /leaderboards — content centered within the 980px cap from app/_layout.tsx (visible side gutters in screenshots) ✓. Gameplay HUD at 1440: lane-key-hint-1..4 read A/S/D/F, highway centered ✓. Editor at 1440: editor-board + editor-timeline + editor-play-button + editor-undo-button + editor-tool-tap all visible, timeline bottom=768 < viewport 900 (fits in viewport without scroll) ✓. No deprecated packages detected. No React Native red screens. No new console errors.

action_items: No code changes required. All four features in the review (copy/paste editor flow, desktop two-column + centered layouts for 1440x900, auto-performance toggle above performance-mode toggle, and perf-mode gameplay without crash) are live-verified working on preview.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx L49: PERFORMANCE MODE section ordering is correct — auto-performance-toggle is rendered FIRST, then performance-mode-toggle, matching the spec. The auto toggle also carries dual-write updateSettings({ autoPerformance: value, perfLite: false }) which cleanly resets the lite-visual override whenever the user toggles auto on/off. Copy string switches between 'Slow device detected · lite visuals on to stay smooth & cool' and 'Detects lag and switches to lite visuals automatically' depending on state — matches the spec intent.

/app/frontend/src/editor/Inspector.tsx L18-50: copy/paste/duplicate buttons are correctly wired. Copy label is dynamic ('Copy {notes.length}') and Paste label switches to 'Paste {clipCount}' with gold tint when there is clipboard content — great UX. editor-inspector-copy, editor-inspector-duplicate, editor-inspector-paste, editor-inspector-close testIDs match the review spec exactly.

/app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx L90: Width-cap frame uses path to pick maxWidth — /game is uncapped (full viewport for highway), / caps at 1240, /editor at 1180, everything else at 980. This is a clean centralized approach to desktop layout and does not require per-screen code (spec compliant).

/app/frontend/app/index.tsx L112-229: desktop two-column via useWindowDimensions width >= DESKTOP_MIN; main column has tutorial card + Quick Play carousel + Play button, side column has daily challenge + mode grid + profile snapshot. SIDE_W=400 fixed, main column flex:1 — layout at 1440 verified non-overlapping (main right=899, side left=922).

Pre-existing deprecation console warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web) are RN-Web shims unchanged from iter15/16/17 and do NOT affect behaviour. Treesh.app CORS failures are expected in preview and do not block the app.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of reviewed flows — settings toggle order+persistence, gameplay A/S/D/F score increments, perf-mode gameplay without crash, editor copy/paste/duplicate/undo chain, and desktop 1440x900 layouts for home/library/shop/settings/guide/leaderboards/gameplay/editor all live-verified.

seed_data_creation: None. Voco Warmup (built-in song-card-neon-warmup) is a bundled asset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com. For gameplay tests, click guide-play-tutorial-button via page.mouse.click(bbox center) — Pressable.click(force=True) works for most buttons but mouse.click is the most reliable path for the NeonButton gradient surface. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' NOT 'networkidle' (treesh.app CORS requests never finish and will hang networkidle for 30s). Editor board uses onResponderGrant so marquee selection must go page.mouse.down -> move(dx,dy,steps=10) -> up. React Native Switch on web does NOT expose aria-checked; assert toggle state visually (screenshot) or by inspecting internal state via a derived DOM change rather than aria. All features in this iter are stable; no retest expected unless touching settings.tsx L49 (PERFORMANCE MODE section) or editor.tsx copy/paste wiring or app/_layout.tsx L90 maxWidth logic.
